productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Sing-along and dance to holiday classics performed by your favorite Disney Junior characters! Join a cast of Disney Junior characters including Mickey Mouse, Muppet Babies, Puppy Dog Pals and many others for a festive music party. Get ready for original songs and covers of timeless holiday classics. From “Jingle Bells” to “Let It Snow”, “Dreidel Song” to “Deck The Halls”, this Yoto Card will make the perfect soundtrack to any holiday get together! Tracks included: Holiday Party (Opening) Deck The Halls Let It Snow (Doc McStuffins) Hot Dog! Dance Break 2019 (Christmas Version) Gotta Make Latkes (Puppy Dog Pals) Dreidel Song (Puppy Dog Pals) You Can Be a Dancer - Holiday Version (Muppet Babies) Baby’s First Christmas (T.O.T.S.) Jingle Bell Rock (Vampirina) Wassalia (Sofia the First) Jingle Bells Navidad Medley (Elena of Avalor) Disney Junior Shinin’ Star

productOnPage.descriptionMarkdown:
**_Yoto Says: Sing-along and dance to holiday classics performed by your favorite Disney Junior characters!._**

Join a cast of Disney Junior characters including Mickey Mouse, Muppet Babies, Puppy Dog Pals and many others for a festive music party. Get ready for original songs and covers of timeless holiday classics. From “Jingle Bells” to “Let It Snow”, “Dreidel Song” to “Deck The Halls”, this Yoto Card will make the perfect soundtrack to any holiday get together!

Tracks included:

*   Holiday Party (Opening)
*   Deck The Halls
*   Let It Snow (Doc McStuffins)
*   Hot Dog! Dance Break 2019 (Christmas Version)
*   Gotta Make Latkes (Puppy Dog Pals)
*   Dreidel Song (Puppy Dog Pals)
*   You Can Be a Dancer - Holiday Version (Muppet Babies)
*   Baby’s First Christmas (T.O.T.S.)
*   Jingle Bell Rock (Vampirina)
*   Wassalia (Sofia the First)
*   Jingle Bells
*   Navidad Medley (Elena of Avalor)
*   Disney Junior Shinin’ Star

yotoCreatorModal.body:
#### Who are Creators on Yoto?

Creators are independent audio makers bringing their original stories, games, songs and more to Yoto Cards. We hand-pick the best and freshest ideas — so every Creators Card meets the Yoto gold standard.

[Explore the Creators Collection](/creators/)

[Read Creator biographies](https://yoto.space/creator-profiles)
